purpose: Collapse the active TRUMP P-vs-NP program into one universal proof obligation rather than extending an unbounded portfolio of local routes.

formal_target.statement: There exist fixed constants c,d and one deterministic answer-blind constructor D such that, for every 3-CNF input F of encoded size N and every state S reachable from F under D, D(S) emits either an exact certified terminal decision or an exact proof-carrying decomposition/transition; the complete live encoded state, discovery/compilation/local work, proof generation, and verification are each bounded by N^c in the original input size N; every nonterminal macrostep strictly decreases an integer-valued rank Phi_F(S) in {0,...,ceil(N^d)}; and the final SAT witness or UNSAT certificate is independently replayable against F in polynomial time.
formal_target.quantifiers: EXISTS fixed D,c,d FORALL 3CNF F FORALL D-reachable S

required_obligations.requirement: Every nonterminal reachable state has a D-admissible certified next macrostep or terminal decision; OPEN cannot persist on any 3-CNF input.
Every terminal/decomposition/transition is exact for satisfiability and carries independently checkable proof metadata.

Discovery, representation switching, compilation, local solving, proof generation and verification are each bounded by N^c in the original input size N, including bit complexity and serialized evidence.
The total live encoded state, decomposition frontier, deferred debt and proof material never exceed N^c in the original input size N.

For every original input F of size N, there is one fixed constructor-defined integer rank Phi_F on reachable states with 0 <= Phi_F(S) <= ceil(N^d), and every admitted nonterminal macrostep decreases Phi_F by at least 1. Therefore every run has at most ceil(N^d) nonterminal macrosteps.
The composed result is independently replayable against the original CNF in polynomial time, including witness lifting across every representation/decomposition boundary.

design_consequence_from_R44X: Any successful universal D must preserve or derive genuinely third-order/global/compositional information; no exact decision rule that is solely a function of order<=2 signed literal marginals can satisfy L1+L2.
